name: clip_rv4mmHg
title: Diseased valve + clip in BiV, RV 4 mmHg
description: Run 01_clip_rv4mmHg: A1S2 clip, annulus tied to the 3 mm diseased wall, RV + trunk pressurized to 4 mmHg (t = 0.16–0.21 s).

name: echo_tv_D-02-S-03-b_t0032
title: Baseline chordae (t0032)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-02-S-03-b reconstructed from echo. 49 chordae to 3 papillary points, ventricular pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s.

name: echo_tv_D-02-S-03-b_belly_col0PM4_clamped_p23
title: Belly chordae + PM4, clamped annulus, 23 mmHg (identification valve)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-02-S-03-b from echo. Pareto trial 32 (49 free-edge chordae, 3 papillary points) plus 24 belly chordae and a 4th papillary point under commissure col 0 (82 chordae), annulus rotation clamped, pressure ramped smoothly to 23 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s. The geometry used for the (G, t) identification; this solve is the pipeline's uniform neo-Hookean leaflet at the box centre, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.

name: echo_tv_D-03-S-02_t0043
title: Rule-based chordae, Pareto trial 43 (closes)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-03-S-02 from echo. Rule-based free-edge chordae (49 chordae to 3 papillary points) from the 60-trial Pareto search, trial 43 on the feasible front (open area 2.3 mm2, contact 344 mm2 in the search). Pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s, annulus pinned. Uniform neo-Hookean leaflet, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.

name: echo_tv_D-07-S-01_t0046
title: Rule-based chordae, Pareto trial 46 (does not close)
description: Patient tricuspid valve D-07-S-01 from echo. Rule-based free-edge chordae (47 chordae to 3 papillary points), trial 46 of a 60-trial Pareto search in which no trial met the closure constraint: smallest orifice (open area 88 mm2, contact 146 mm2 in the search), X-shaped regurgitant gap. Pressure ramped smoothly to 20 mmHg over 0-0.05 s then held to 0.1 s, annulus pinned. Uniform neo-Hookean leaflet, G = 29.5 kPa, t = 0.6725 mm.
